finalText:
**Redis died at `02:14:07` and never came back.** That took the service down 17 minutes later.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, store overloaded |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes the 500 cap |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies, `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED` on the same host. No good request logged after `02:14:03`. Next step is to check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
